# Florence 1490 – Medicine & hygiene

<!-- generated by scripts/build_techtree.py from eras/europe-1490-florence.yaml — do not edit -->

K = knowledge level · use = none/wrong/partial/correct · make = producibility with local means · accept = acceptance.

- **Contagion by invisible living agents (germ theory)** [`contagion_theory`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/contagion_theory.md) — K2, use partial, make medium, accept low. Ficino describes plague passing between people while also invoking corrupted air. Varro's account of invisible creatures is in print. Neither identifies a specific organism. Local: Marsilio Ficino; Antonio Benivieni.
- **Abandoning bloodletting, purging and mercury (end of humoral medicine)** [`bloodletting_harm`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/bloodletting_harm.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Patients expect bleeding, purging and cupping. Physicians prescribe bleeding and barbers perform it, including when further blood loss can harm the patient. Local: Arte dei Medici e Speziali; barbers who perform bloodletting.
- **Counting and mapping cases to find causes (epidemiology)** [`epidemiology_mapping`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/epidemiology_mapping.md) — K1, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Surviving burial series start in 1385 for the Grascia and 1450 for the medical guild. The Grascia records burial places and gravediggers. Local: Libri dei morti of the Grascia and of the Arte dei Medici e Speziali. Elsewhere: Milan, surviving civic death register for 1452 with causes of death.
- **Hand washing with soap** [`hand_hygiene`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/hand_hygiene.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Handwashing before meals is familiar, and soap and basins are available. Routine cleaning between patients to prevent transmission would require a change in practice. Local: Arte dei Medici e Speziali (guild of physicians and apothecaries).
- **Boiling drinking water and protecting wells** [`boiled_water`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/boiled_water.md) — K2, use none, make easy, accept medium. Avicenna's Canon recommends boiling suspect water. Florence draws on wells and the Arno. Fuel costs matter if households are to boil water routinely. Elsewhere: China, habitual tea drinking.
- **Slow sand filtration and chlorination of town water** [`water_filtration_chlorination`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/water_filtration_chlorination.md) — K1, use none, make medium, accept medium. Venice uses sand-filtered rainwater cisterns. Tuscan masons could build a filter. Reliable chlorination would require a chemical supply and controlled dosing. Elsewhere: Venice, rainwater cisterns that filter through a bed of sand.
- **Latrines and sewers (keeping excrement out of water, food and soil)** [`sanitation_sewerage`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/sanitation_sewerage.md) — K3, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Cesspits (pozzi neri) are emptied at night and sold to gardeners; they leak into the well water. Dyers, tanners and butchers discharge into the Arno. Local: cesspit emptiers (votapozzi); Arno; Ufficiali della Grascia.
- **Food hygiene (cooking, flies, carriers)** [`food_hygiene`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/food_hygiene.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Market officers inspect meat and fish and condemn spoiled goods. Smell and visible decay guide inspection. Local: Mercato Vecchio; Ufficiali della Grascia; butchers' guild (Beccai).
- **Quarantine and isolation of the sick** [`quarantine`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/quarantine.md) — K4, use partial, make easy, accept high. Florence appoints officials during epidemics. Isolation and restrictions on travel are familiar measures. Merchants have reason to contest a closure. Local: Florentine plague officials; San Bastiano outside the walls (under construction). Elsewhere: Venice, island lazaretto; Milan, health office; Ragusa, isolation of arrivals.
- **Hospital hygiene and trained nursing** [`nursing_hospital_hygiene`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/nursing_hospital_hygiene.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Santa Maria Nuova provides nursing, meals and clean linen, with separate accommodation for men and women. Its staff and accounts offer a starting point for reform. Local: Ospedale di Santa Maria Nuova; Ospedale degli Innocenti (foundlings).
- **Cholera and typhoid spread through drinking water** [`cholera_waterborne`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/cholera_waterborne.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Epidemic Asiatic cholera is outside contemporary Florentine experience. Summer diarrhoeal illnesses are familiar, but chronicles seldom distinguish modern diagnoses.
- **Oral rehydration (water, salt and sugar)** [`oral_rehydration`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/oral_rehydration.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Salt is taxed and apothecaries sell costly sugar. Clean water and accurate proportions matter more than costly drugs for replacing losses from diarrhoea.
- **Plague carried by rats and fleas (and by coughing)** [`plague_vectors`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/plague_vectors.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Rats and fleas are everywhere and unremarkable. Dogs and cats are sometimes killed in epidemics (wrong). Cloth and bedding are rightly suspected.
- **Typhus carried by body lice (delousing)** [`typhus_lice`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/typhus_lice.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Lice are familiar, but their role in epidemic fever is unknown. Historical descriptions of camp fevers do not always distinguish the infections involved.
- **Malaria carried by mosquitoes (drainage, nets)** [`malaria_mosquito`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/malaria_mosquito.md) — K1, use partial, make medium, accept medium. Marsh fevers (tertian, quartan) are blamed on bad air. Avoiding marshes in summer works for the wrong reason. Drainage is costly; gauze nets are cheap. Local: Maremma; Pisan plain; Val di Chiana; Padule di Fucecchio.
- **Cinchona bark (quinine) against malaria** [`quinine`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/quinine.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept high. Cinchona grows in the Andes. Florentine apothecaries have no source for its bark. Elsewhere: Andean forests, source of cinchona bark.
- **Consumption (tuberculosis) is contagious** [`tuberculosis_control`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/tuberculosis_control.md) — K2, use none, make easy, accept low. Avicenna's Canon, the standard textbook, lists phthisis as catching, but physicians treat it as an inherited constitution. Families nurse the sick at home.
- **Parasitic worms (hookworm, roundworm, tapeworm, guinea worm)** [`parasitic_worms`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/parasitic_worms.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Worms are seen and treated with wormseed and bitter herbs. They are thought to breed from rotting humours; eggs, soil and undercooked pork are not suspected. Local: apothecaries (wormseed, santonica).
- **Fresh food prevents scurvy (citrus, vitamin C)** [`scurvy_citrus`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/scurvy_citrus.md) — K1, use none, make easy, accept medium. Preserved shipboard provisions can leave crews short of fresh food. Citrus is available in Mediterranean ports and in Medici gardens.
- **Deficiency diseases (beriberi, rickets, pellagra, goitre, night blindness)** [`vitamins_deficiency`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/vitamins_deficiency.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept low. Disease from a missing food is an alien idea. Goitre is common in Alpine and Apennine valleys and blamed on the water. Liver for night blindness is in ancient authors.
- **Variolation (inoculation with smallpox matter)** [`variolation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/variolation.md) — K0, use none, make hard, accept low. Smallpox is familiar. Deliberate exposure entails severe disease and risks spreading an outbreak. A dependable and acceptable local practice would be difficult to establish.
- **Smallpox vaccination with cowpox** [`smallpox_vaccination`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/smallpox_vaccination.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept low. Smallpox is endemic, mostly a children's disease. Cowpox must be found on cattle in the contado; finding it is a quest.
- **Vaccines from weakened or killed germs** [`vaccines_attenuated`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/vaccines_attenuated.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Antitoxin serum (passive immunisation)** [`antitoxin_serum`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/antitoxin_serum.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept low
- **Wound care (stop bleeding, clean, tie vessels, leave dirty wounds open)** [`wound_care`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/wound_care.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Italian surgical traditions differ on pus and cautery. Theodoric recommended wine dressings. Celsus on tying bleeding vessels was printed in Florence in 1478. Local: Surgeons at Santa Maria Nuova; Florentine surgeons trained by apprenticeship or university study.
- **Antiseptics (strong spirit, chlorinated lime, carbolic acid, iodine)** [`antiseptics`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/antiseptics.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Wine, vinegar and sometimes aqua vitae are put on wounds without a theory. Strong spirit is easy to make; chlorinated lime and carbolic acid are not. Local: apothecaries; monastery stills.
- **Sterilising instruments and dressings by heat** [`heat_sterilisation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/heat_sterilisation.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Boiling instruments and laundering linen are within a hospital's means. Systematic heat treatment between patients would require fuel and a change in routine.
- **Safe childbirth (clean hands, patience, cord care, forceps)** [`childbirth_care`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/childbirth_care.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept low. Midwives and female relatives attend most births at home. Ancient texts describe turning a child in difficult labour. Obstetric forceps are unavailable. Local: midwives (levatrici); Ospedale degli Innocenti.
- **First aid and resuscitation** [`first_aid_resuscitation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/first_aid_resuscitation.md) — K0, use none, make easy, accept medium. Bystanders lack a standard method for recognising cardiac arrest or resuscitating an apparently lifeless casualty.
- **Ether anaesthesia** [`ether_anaesthesia`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/ether_anaesthesia.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept medium. Both ingredients (strong aqua vitae, oil of vitriol) are available to alchemists and apothecaries. Dangerous near fire. Surgeons know the unreliable opium-mandrake sleeping sponge. Local: apothecaries; alchemists.
- **Pain relief with opium and willow bark (laudanum, morphine, aspirin)** [`opium_analgesia`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/opium_analgesia.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept high. Apothecaries stock opium, mostly inside theriac at unknown strength; mandrake and henbane too. Willow bark is in Dioscorides but unused for fever. Dosing is guesswork. Local: apothecaries (speziali); Venice (theriac, opium imports from Egypt).
- **Blood groups and transfusion** [`blood_groups_transfusion`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/blood_groups_transfusion.md) — K0, use none, make very-hard, accept low. Blood is thought to be made in the liver and consumed. No hollow needles, no way to test compatibility; an attempt will probably kill.
- **Human anatomy from dissection** [`anatomy_dissection`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/anatomy_dissection.md) — K3, use partial, make easy, accept medium. Florentine physicians sometimes seek family permission for an autopsy. Dissections also serve medical teaching. Benivieni's case histories offer local examples. Local: Antonio Benivieni; Santa Maria Nuova; Studio at Pisa. Elsewhere: Bologna and Padua, anatomy teaching; Milan, Leonardo's skull drawings of 1489; Rome, Florentine artist Antonio del Pollaiuolo.
- **Circulation of the blood** [`blood_circulation`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/blood_circulation.md) — K0, use none, make medium, accept low. Galen: blood ebbs and flows, passes through pores in the heart wall. The arm-ligature demonstration of vein valves needs no equipment. Ibn al-Nafis is unknown here.
- **Physical diagnosis (percussion, stethoscope, thermometer, pulse count)** [`clinical_thermometer_stethoscope`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/clinical_thermometer_stethoscope.md) — K1, use none, make medium, accept medium. Physicians assess pulse by touch. In 1450 Cusanus proposed weighing water discharged during a counted run of pulse beats. Glassworkers could attempt a thermometer. Local: glassblowers; physicians' uroscopy.
- **Tooth decay and dental care** [`dental_care`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/dental_care.md) — K1, use wrong, make easy, accept medium. Toothache is blamed on a tooth worm, treated with henbane smoke; barbers and fairground tooth-drawers extract. Sugar is still a luxury, so decay is moderate.

- **Penicillin (antibiotics from mould)** [`penicillin`](https://blueprintsfromtomorrow.com/techtree/generated/tech/penicillin.md) — K0, use none, make impossible, accept medium. Apothecaries have no way to identify penicillin or supply a preparation of predictable purity and strength.
